said ironically: with which Paleius compared similar examples, such as Eurip. Andr. 235 ὡς δὴ σὺ σώφρων, τἀμὰ δ᾽ οὐχὶ σώφρονα [as if you are prudent, but my affairs are not prudent].
Wishing what indeed?
And why indeed do you lament over them for what they have done?
Why indeed did you not yourself kill this man from your evil soul?
Why indeed do you keep the suppliant from the gates?
Where indeed have you brought me, wretched as I am?
Where indeed are the dominions of the dead?
Where indeed are you walking?
How indeed?
How indeed and where to end?
Where indeed are the remaining oracles of Loxias?
When indeed shall we show the strength of our mouths?
And you indeed have come as a spectator of my toils,
as now indeed yours.
This indeed I will make clear.
Leaving these things indeed I come to the gold-robed halls.
Who indeed will find a flame stronger than the thunderbolt.
Or indeed this second oracle of the mother was seated.
This life-giving race is truly of Zeus.
Divinities, who indeed guard these towers of Cadmus.
of man-destroying beasts, which indeed the earth sent up.
from which indeed Rhegium is called.
where indeed the long colony, Io, is fated for you and your children to found.
from which indeed our race.
It has an end indeed.
Now indeed the curses of the father are fulfilled.
The best indeed of the things then present seemed to me to be.
With such accusations indeed does Zeus torment you?
Only indeed before – I saw.
The seventh indeed this one at the seventh gates I will speak of.
The highest indeed of evils I hear these things.
Alas, a great sea of evils indeed has burst forth.
Hard to war against indeed is the race of the Persians.
The whole indeed they hear the grief.
So beautiful indeed is even death to me.
another indeed (ἀλλὰ M) some Scylla
and such an army having done many indeed evils to the Medes.
with which you indeed often slumbering at the same time.
or having suffered many indeed things and in vain I.
There indeed Zeus makes you sane.
These things have been seen long indeed.
There indeed most died.
Come indeed, let everyone prepare the sword with hilt forward.
A cry indeed throughout the city.
It is being accomplished indeed and this deed is not in vain,
For you indeed the command of Zeus has its end.
Do you think indeed that you dwell in sorrowless citadels?
AN. He destroyed indeed this. IS. And he deprived us of this.
May the good things indeed be accomplished.
These indeed are multiplying.
You think indeed that I share in this land.
The house indeed is inspired.
Listen indeed.
Come indeed.
Come indeed and let us begin the dance.
Come indeed let us speak.
